name: farmer-runtime
comment: Minimal runtime dependency set for the production image. The web app and jobs are bundled into app.js by `bun build` (see Dockerfile); vite's SSR build (dist/server) bundles react/tanstack/base-ui/lucide/drizzle/postgres/etc. into itself. Only these packages survive as bare imports at runtime: better-auth + framer-motion/motion (vite leaves them external), the drizzle-orm + postgres peers better-auth's drizzle adapter resolves from node_modules, and the native typst compiler (can't be bundled). Keep versions in lockstep with apps/web/package.json + packages/core/package.json. docker/bun.lock pins the transitive graph and the image installs with --frozen-lockfile; without it every rebuild of the same commit resolved transitives fresh, so two builds of one tag were not the same image. Regenerate it whenever a version here changes: cp docker/runtime.package.json /tmp/rt/package.json && (cd /tmp/rt && bun install --lockfile-only) && cp /tmp/rt/bun.lock docker/bun.lock
